# Environment variables

muckrake reads these from the environment, after loading the nearest `.env` file from the current directory upward (see `MUCKRAKE_ENV_FILE`). `.env.example` is a commented template.

| Variable | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `MUCKRAKE_DATABASE_URL` | `sqlite:///data/muckrake.db` | Working database: crawl runs, loaded statements, resolver, NER candidates, HTTP cache, releases. A `postgresql://` URL selects Postgres. |
| `MUCKRAKE_PUBLISHED_DATABASE_URL` | the working database URL | Read-only serving database that `release-publish` writes. **Must differ from the working database**: `release-publish` refuses to run otherwise. |
| `MUCKRAKE_DATA_PATH` | `data` | Directory for the default SQLite database, dataset workspaces (`<path>/datasets/<name>/`) and the LevelDB store. |
| `MUCKRAKE_ARTIFACT_PATH` | `<MUCKRAKE_DATA_PATH>/artifacts` | Immutable crawl and release artifacts. |
| `MUCKRAKE_DATASET_PATHS` | unset | Extra dataset roots, separated by the OS path separator (`:` on Unix). `./datasets/` in the current directory is always searched. |
| `MUCKRAKE_FTM_SCHEMA_PATHS` | unset | FollowTheMoney schema extension directories, separated by the OS path separator. `./ftm_schema_ext/` in the current directory is always used if present. |
| `MUCKRAKE_ENV_FILE` | nearest `.env` from the current directory upward | Explicit `.env` file to load. |
| `MUCKRAKE_HTTP_MIN_INTERVAL` | `0` | Minimum seconds between HTTP requests to the same host (politeness rate limit). |
| `MUCKRAKE_PROFILE_URL` | unset | Link template for entities in the `dedupe` review TUI, with `%s` for the entity ID, e.g. `https://example.org/entity/%s`. Unset shows no links. |
| `FTM_MODEL_PATH` | set by muckrake | FollowTheMoney model directory. muckrake sets it to the upstream model merged with any schema extensions; set it only to override that. |
| `LLM_MODEL` | unset | Model for `ner-extract --extractor llm`, with its provider prefix: `openrouter:<model>` or `anthropic:<model>`. |
| `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` | unset | API key for `openrouter:` models. |
| `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` | unset | API key for `anthropic:` models. |
| `NER_LLM_PROMPT_FILE` | built-in prompt | File whose text replaces the LLM extractor's system prompt. |
| `LOGFIRE_TOKEN` | unset | Send LLM extraction traces to Logfire when set. |
| `ENVIRONMENT` | `development` | Environment name reported to Logfire. `production` skips loading `.env`. |
